name: Mehrun Handloom Chanderi Three Piece
description: Woven from luminous Mulberry and Chanderi silk in our signature Deep Wine palette, the Mehrun Three Piece features delicate tonal resham needlework along the neckline and sleeve borders, paired with a whisper-light organza dupatta edged in antique zari.
fabricDetails: Kameez: Pure Handloom Chanderi Silk (3.0 yds) | Trouser: Dyed Raw Silk (2.5 yds) | Dupatta: Silk Organza with Zari Selvedge (2.75 yds)
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Store folded in breathable muslin away from direct sunlight. Steam on reverse at low heat.

name: Niloufer Soft Sage Silk-Organza Three Piece
description: A serene celebration of understated luxury. The Niloufer Three Piece pairs soft sage green pure silk-organza with ivory French-knot botanical motifs, completed by a scalloped shadow-work dupatta and breathable cotton-silk lining.
fabricDetails: Kameez: Pure Silk-Organza with Mulmul Lining (3.0 yds) | Trouser: Fine Cotton-Silk (2.5 yds) | Dupatta: Hand-Embroidered Organza (2.75 yds)
careInstructions: Professional dry clean recommended. Do not wring or bleach. Press gently over a pressing cloth.

name: Zohra Ivory Tissue & Antique Zari Three Piece
description: Crafted for intimate soirées and timeless occasions, the Zohra ensemble glows in warm ivory tissue silk. Subtle antique gold kasab threads trace architectural borders across the hem and cuffs for an heirloom finish.
fabricDetails: Kameez: Handwoven Tissue Silk (3.0 yds) | Trouser: Pure Katan Silk (2.5 yds) | Dupatta: Zari Woven Organza (2.75 yds)
careInstructions: Dry clean only. Wrap zari borders in acid-free tissue paper to preserve luster.

name: Aria Ivory Raw Silk Tailored Two Piece
description: Architectural yet fluid, the Aria Two Piece comprises a long structured tunic with deep wine contrast piping and relaxed wide-leg trousers. Available in standard boutique sizes or custom tailored to your exact posture and proportions.
fabricDetails: Tunic & Trouser: 100% Spun Mulberry Raw Silk with breathable cotton voile inner lining and mother-of-pearl closures.
careInstructions: Dry clean or gentle cold hand wash with silk detergent. Hang dry in shade.

name: Safa Soft Sage Pintuck Linen-Silk Two Piece
description: Designed for effortless daytime refinement, the Safa Two Piece blends Belgian linen with fine tussar silk. Knife-edge pintucks elongate the silhouette while the straight-cut ankle trousers offer poise and comfort.
fabricDetails: 65% Belgian Linen, 35% Tussar Silk blend. Pre-washed for softness and drape.
careInstructions: Gentle cold wash separately or dry clean. Warm steam iron while slightly damp.

name: Noor Hand-Pleated Mulmul Silk Tunic Top
description: Delicate heirloom pin-tucks and hand-carved mother-of-pearl buttons define the Noor Tunic Top. Cut from featherweight cotton-silk mulmul in warm ivory, it transitions effortlessly from workdays to evening gatherings.
fabricDetails: 80% Fine Combed Mulmul Cotton, 20% Mulberry Silk. Genuine shell buttons.
careInstructions: Hand wash cold with mild soap. Lay flat in shade to dry.

name: Soraya Deep Wine Handloom Silk Kurta Top
description: Richly dyed in our signature Deep Wine hue, the Soraya Kurta Top features fine tonal threadwork along the mandarin collar and gathered bishop cuffs. Tailored for a graceful, skimming drape.
fabricDetails: 100% Handloom Matka Silk with soft mercerized cotton trim.
careInstructions: Dry clean preferred. Cool iron on reverse side.
